title: Single and multi-instance Flex trace comparison
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Compare single/multi-instance Flex traces; unknown completion or grace limits cannot be certified away.

sourceContract.readme: Functions, Flex Consumption: Test rolling site updates, mixed-version compatibility, execution grace limits, and sufficient multi-instance capacity.
sourceContract.backlog: Add available Flex rolling-update presets, including multi-instance and single-instance comparisons.
sourceContract.acceptance: Real grace/version/capacity behavior is measured; single-instance downtime and unobservable completion are disclosed rather than reported as guaranteed continuity.
sourceContract.portableCard: Compare single/multi-instance Flex traces; unknown completion or grace limits cannot be certified away.
sourceContract.nativeSibling: Conduct one available Flex preset; verify native grace/version observations and explicitly bounded conclusions.

documentedConstraints.slots: Flex Consumption does not use deployment slots.
documentedConstraints.executionTimeout: Unbounded maximum execution timeout is not an unlimited restart or scale-in grace guarantee.
documentedConstraints.singleInstance: Single-instance applications can experience brief downtime during rolling updates even when in-progress executions complete.
documentedConstraints.compatibility: Old and new versions coexist; changes must be backward compatible, including state and effect contracts.
documentedConstraints.capacity: Batch count, sizes and drain intervals are platform-managed. Scale-out is asynchronous and is not guaranteed before the next drain interval.
documentedConstraints.completion: No real-time batch/progress visibility or built-in completion signal. Instance log turnover is a best-effort estimate, not authoritative completion or a production automation gate.
documentedConstraints.recreate: Recreate restarts instances and forcefully terminates running executions; rolling grace cannot be borrowed.
documentedConstraints.availability: Native availability, region behavior and current platform limits must be independently checked for an approved target. No target or capability has been validated here.
documentedConstraints.qualification: Documentation, fixed fictional observations and native Azure evidence are distinct. Instance count or a documented grace window never proves all users, all executions or the whole fleet completed.

preconditions: All plans, instances, executions, restarts, grace, state, effects, latency and outcomes are fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY.
Eight exact presets; single-compatible and multi-compatible compare the same three started tracking journeys.
Executions are asynchronous teaching work, not HTTP responses kept open for minutes.
Each polling journey must observe v1 to v2, preserved identity/state, one business effect and completed work within its original 900 ms polling budget.
Fleet update completion is unknown in every preset, including the bounded positive sample.
actions: Choose one fixed preset and load trace DATA using the exact string token v2.
Inspect capacity, mixed versions, restarts, execution completion and observed versus documented grace DATA.
Measure all three attempted journeys with separate positive, interrupted and unknown outcomes.
Repeat a complete run while retaining earlier failures and unknowns, up to four runs/twelve actions.
Reset only this page's in-memory rehearsal.
assertions: Explicit typed load advances to loaded but does not measure a journey; inspection must precede measurement.
Single-compatible records a polling interruption while its three existing executions complete; multi-compatible is only a three-journey positive sample.
HTTP 200, three instances or a grace reference cannot conceal state loss, duplicate effects, insufficient ready capacity, latency failures or termination.
Rolling 3600-second, platform-update 600-second and recreate termination references remain distinct.
Unknown observed grace, execution, effects, migration and fleet completion remain unknown; all attempted journeys stay counted.
Exact records/types, allowlists, descriptor guards and deterministic state-history replay reject coercion, accessors, forged results and out-of-order commands without mutation.
All twelve actions/four runs remain retained without pruning; a thirteenth action requires explicit reset.
Keyboard labels/focus, visible alerts/status, prototype-based native form reset and missing-model failure are actually observed.
Actual browser CSP denies inline script, eval, inline style, connections, images, frames and form navigation without network or unsafe flags.
Normal verification is read-only; exact CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 alone deliberately creates unique browser captures.
